notes: Environmental accident is an unplanned and unwanted event that can directly or indirectly cause damage to the environment and public health, as well as social and economic losses

organization.description: The Brazilian Institute of the Environment and Renewable Natural Resources (Ibama) is a federal agency with legal personality under public law, administrative and financial autonomy, linked to the Ministry of the Environment (MMA), according to Art. 2 of  Law No. 7,735, of February 22, 1989 .

title: Brazil - Environmental Accident

resources.description: The National Environmental Emergencies System (Siema from the Brazilian acronym) is a tool for reporting environmental accidents, visualizing interactive maps and generating statistical data on environmental accidents registered by IBAMA.
